description: Arson (6.8), not a numbered 17 test. The incident is appended (lot AddRef'd); for a type with the arson flag, when the lot has a building and the city has a disaster layer, the fire manager ignites the building and sets the cause 2; then 0x0A159D95 is posted (data1 = type, the lot, the type name); the severity is returned. Without a disaster layer there is no fire, but the incident and the post remain. The arson type is chosen through the walk (lot condition 4, total 20.5, r = 3.25 -> Arson). Shutdown releases the incident lots. The name is empty: Arson's shipped name key (0x2026960B, 0x0A554AE0, 0xCA5EA698) has no LTEXT here, as in the shipped locale (7). Hand-derived.
